messages:
Maria K: Quick thread to capture action items from today's customer-facing postmortem (ACME private deployment). Root cause summary in the doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/ACME-2026-03 — peering flaps + a failover path that leaked tenant routes. Need owners, short timelines, and a small recurring checkpoint.

Ajay P: Saw that. Two separate failure modes: (1) BGP/peering state flapping because of aggressive reattempts; (2) our onprem adapter not cleaning netns routes on failover. Both amplified by autoscaler churning.

Kenan O: I'll take VPC peering stabilization. Plan: add a liveness probe, track consecutive fail counts as metric, and implement exponential backoff when the peer is down. Goal: prototype probe + dashboard tile by next Tue. Will file RN-7901.

Eli R: I'll own the route hygiene fix in the runtime. Implementation: ensure per-tenant route table teardown before failover completes and add an e2e that does detach->failover->reattach sequences. ETA: Friday COB. Ticket RN-7902.

Jordan Ops: I'll handle the customer checklist and verify ACME's exported edge configs (iptables rules, BGP neighbors, timestamps). Asking @acme-eng for a tarball of configs and the peering session logs. I'll validate and publish a minimal guidance doc for onprem teams. ETA: 24h.

acme-eng: sharing configs now — s3 link: s3://acme-share/peering-exports/2026-03-22.tar.gz. Included bgpd.pcap + confs.

SRE Bot: Auto-created RN-7901, RN-7902, RN-7903 (ops checklist). Linked to incident INC-4601. Severity set to P2.

Ajay P: Short-term guardrail: can we pause scale-up events when a peer has >3 consecutive failures? That would limit thrash. Who can design? @Kenan O?

Kenan O: I'll draft an autoscale inhibition flag in the routing controller and make it configurable per-deployment. Draft design by Monday. Will coordinate with Jordan Ops for rollout window.

Maria K: I'm spinning up a lightweight tracker spreadsheet and a recurring 15m sync for 3 weeks (Weds 9am PT) so we don't lose momentum. Current owners: Kenan (peering+guardrail), Eli (runtime route hygiene), Jordan (onprem checklist), Ajay (postmortem doc + prioritization). Please add ticket links to the tracker.

Eli R: Note for CI: the harness will run the detach/reattach scenario in a sandbox, assert no persistent tenant routes, and measure time-to-cleanup. Will include repro steps in RN-7902.

Jordan Ops: ACME - can you confirm you saw the exported tarball and that logs cover the outage window (02:10-02:25 UTC)?

acme-eng: Confirmed. Logs are complete for that window. We'll also share a config diff from prior week.

Maria K: Thanks everyone — I'll move updates to the tracker and close this thread. If something slips, ping me and mark the ticket priority. :thumbsup:
